newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex estimates raised.

text.p: SBC Warburg Inc said on Wednesday it was increasing its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for Telfonos de Mxico, as the company prepared its local telephony business for competition.
-- The firm said analyst Zain Manekia raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $4.14 per share from $4.04 and his 1998 earnings estimate to $4.34 per share from $4.22 per share.
-- Manekia also raised his price target to $58 per ADS, or American Depository Share, it said.

-- "Telmex is seriously gearing up its local telephony business as competition looks to build an alternative network to by-pass Telmex," it said in a research note. "Already, line growth in the second quarter is looking much better than the first quarter."
-- On the New York Stock Exchange, its shares closed up 5/8 at 47-1/2.
